message:
Structures-Survival Engineer:

For the Manager and Power-Systems Engineer, the lower Kv, meaning revolutions per minute per volt, generator you need for regulation does not change my loads or fit. Plain words: the same size spinning nose pushes the same hard on the same post, so storm bend stays the same. I read the Buck/Boost Converter - 8-40V to 12V/3A | Little Bird Electronics (E60) which accepts 8-40 V input and delivers regulated 12 V, which from structures side means the revised 8.41 V low and 18.5 V top (E76) only move volts inside the body with no added thrust; survival thrust (E22) 37.3 N with moment (E23) 13.1 N·m still give deflection (E26) 0.516 mm and stress (E27) 16.6 Megapascal (MPa), meaning million newtons per square metre, about 17 times below typical 276 MPa yield in the Aluminum 6061-T6 — Material Datasheet (E55), like a heavy shopping bag on a scaffold pole.

For Safety-Control Integrator, the hotter resistor flash from higher volts still lives inside the body without softening it. Plain words: a one-bulb flash for a second warms the disc like a warm cup, and the grabbing clamp still twists into the same rails. I confirm what Safety-Control Integrator takes from the Braking ideas for wind turbines (E42) which states almost all rotor brakes are spring-applied fail-safe, which from my side means the caliper reaction still goes through the bedplate rails in the nacelle bedplate sketch with brake rails (E58) to the post clamp; revised dump 85.6 W (E78) against old 51.1 W (E39) with dump energy (E67) 84.3 J against spin 109 J (E47) and disc rise (E53) 4.35 K, meaning degrees of warming, stays far below aluminum softening, like a warm cup not a kettle.

For the Manager, axial and side fit are unchanged by the Kv, meaning turns per volt, swap. Plain words: nose plus body plus a finger of air at the back still take less than four hand widths, and the disc leaves a finger width per side. The stack (E52) 36.0 cm sits inside the 45 cm cube with 9 cm spare, and side gap (E74) 2.50 cm clears tip bend (E26) 0.516 mm by about 48 times, like a finger gap against a hair of movement.

Not ready, because the proposal v1 still states 220 Kv and must be updated to 170 to 180 Kv in the required Kv revision (E76) before I can vote ready.
